headline: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney Unveils $6.2 Billion Manufacturing Support Plan
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney unveiled a $6.2 billion plan to protect Canada's manufacturing sector, criticizing U.S. tariffs for raising costs for American families and upending traditional trade.
why: Cross-border trade tensions and targeted fiscal subsidies directly impact corporate capital expenditures, manufacturing supply chains, and industrial sector equities.
